items.quote: behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder
items.claim: Rebekah came out carrying a pitcher on her shoulder

items.quote: who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother
items.claim: Rebekah was born to Bethuel; Bethuel was son of Milcah; Milcah was wife of Nahor; Nahor was brother of Abraham
